goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: T003 proves only Phase 0: the app builds, but the homepage remains a local placeholder with no route family, shared design foundation, navigation, or content registry. The largest safe next slice is the plan-backed Phase 1 foundation plus an initial public-site vertical slice. The workspace is not a git checkout, so preservation must rely on filesystem checks. External activation and unsupported public claims remain out of scope.

worker_package.objective: Implement the next coherent local milestone: Paper & Slate semantic design tokens, an accessible responsive public shell, a validated local content registry, and working routes for /, /foundation and its mission/principles/people/funding/roadmap/reports/contact pages, /projects, /projects/[slug], /search, /docs, /governance, and /news. Replace the Phase 0 placeholder with plan-backed, explicitly planned or unreleased, truthful copy; preserve supplied logo artwork; keep docs, governance, and news landing states intentionally minimal until their dedicated slices. Do not add authentication, databases, providers, remote fetches, or external actions.
verify: $hits = rg -n -i 'next-auth|prisma|drizzle-orm|postgres|valkey|rabbitmq|qdrant|keycloak|aws-sdk|@aws-sdk|s3' package.json apps packages; if ($hits) { $hits; exit 1 }

$source = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath '.\plans\assets\logos\paper-and-slate-horizontal-light.svg').Hash; $copy = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath '.\apps\web\public\brand\paper-and-slate-horizontal-light.svg').Hash; if ($source -ne $copy) { Write-Error 'Supplied light logo artwork changed'; exit 1 }
stop_if: Any write is needed outside allowed_files, including plans, docs/goals, parent directories, or sibling repositories.
The work requires commits, pushes, pull requests, repository creation, Tower/Coolify, DNS, credentials, provider activation, authentication, databases, or remote content fetching.
A public claim about people, funding, adoption, endorsements, legal status, source repositories, releases, or standards maturity cannot be supported by the planning pack or current repository.
The supplied logo cannot be copied byte-for-byte or production imagery would require unverified licensing or provenance.
The route shell requires implementing documentation ingestion, search providers, newsletter delivery, governance registries, news feeds, or other later-phase systems.
Existing files outside allowed_files would be overwritten or unrelated filesystem changes cannot be preserved.
A verification command fails twice for the same in-scope cause, or the required routes do not compile in the production build.
